name: Moonwell mMAMO donated-underlying exchange-rate inflation
summary: mMAMO derives its exchange rate from the market's own MAMO balance, so underlying transferred straight to the market is credited to every existing share while minting none, which the Comptroller's 20,000,000 mint-path supply cap cannot restrain. The attacker accrued interest, read the rate, and transferred 34,910,396.684792645 MAMO into the market in one transaction, then 18,482,893.625840746 more, lifting the stored rate from 205132568127692808921476270 to 754603632406632280153424515 - 3.68 times - against unchanged share supply, and borrowed cbBTC, WETH, USDC, and wstETH against the revalued collateral without repaying.

loss.notes: Moonwell's official post-mortem reconciles $11,028,761.70 of gross borrows across 18 transactions (71.35549505 cbBTC, 623.600287604679454542 WETH, 2,560,000 USDC, 368 wstETH at borrow-block oracles) against 595 liquidation events repaying 17.76122375 cbBTC, 38.573335900949439222 WETH, 215,841.545449 USDC, and 25.307914898863610231 wstETH, leaving $9,131,342 of residual borrower obligations as the permanent pool shortfall. Liquidators repaid out of the attacker's own seized MAMO collateral, so gross victim depletion cannot be isolated from that recovery and the measurement is net. Scope: the residual covers the whole campaign, including five cbBTC borrows totalling 7.79270388 of the 71.35549505 cbBTC (about $622,000 at the borrow-block cbBTC oracle) that preceded the first donation and were carried by the MAMO feed's rise alone; the evidence does not support splitting the shortfall per borrow. The attacker's $1,947,391 seed USDC and its 68,482,886 supplied and directly transferred MAMO are attacker-supplied campaign inputs, not victim depletion. The attempted 2,000,000 AERO borrow transferred nothing and is excluded.

ageReset.description: MIP-B48 listing: the Comptroller's markets(mMAMO) record moved from unlisted with zero collateral factor to listed with a 50 percent factor, emitting MarketListed for mMAMO in the same transaction. This is the later of the two resets - the delegator activated implementation 0x1fadff493529c3fcc7ee04f1f15d19816dda45b7 in its own creation block, 447,556 seconds earlier - because listing made the donation-sensitive exchange rate collateral the Comptroller would lend against.

sources.note: Anchor: 0x056597f42302ab7f9f5e91c7f84856d3ba73827da7f956645d1f26bdde109ce9 (block 50516526:198, 2026-08-27T09:19:59Z) is the earliest transaction that exercises the defect. It is an EIP-7702 self-call by principal 0x719eae70d4a83f35bf82a2740699f5db84be919d whose callTracer trace enters mMAMO 0x2f90bb22eb3979f5ffad31ea6c3f0792ca66da32 six times - accrueInterest, underlying, balanceOf, exchangeRateStored, each DELEGATECALLing implementation 0x1fadff493529c3fcc7ee04f1f15d19816dda45b7 - and then transfers 34,910,396.684792645 MAMO into the market with no Mint event. exchangeRateStored reads 205132568127692808921476270 at block 50516525 and 564395926914084042877489143 at 50516526, and 754603632406632280153424515 at 50516562 after the second 18,482,893.625840746 MAMO transfer (0xaf284d7f60dd8f2ebb41cba6a080e95a6deceb3a2c93ff58016996de61de3cd9, block 50516561), a 3.6786 times peak against unchanged share supply 97172160295247068. The first borrow computed against the inflated rate is 0xafb6f0fa257b115a5c813bf787b4c1535e63888b1d0dbeb1f3788f557f51798f (block 50516532, 14.33812576 cbBTC). Borrow enumeration: filtering Borrow logs across all Moonwell Base markets for borrower 0x719eae70d4a83f35bf82a2740699f5db84be919d returns exactly 18, summing to 71.35549505 cbBTC, 623.600287604679454542 WETH, 2,560,000 USDC, and 368 wstETH, matching the post-mortem. Not the earlier borrow: the post-mortem's first borrow 0x09687d741d92a2607a1d63014104bbad663347a79d7949d0f3073c84a395593e (block 50515423, 08:43:13Z, 0.50071233 cbBTC) predates both donations, ran at the un-inflated rate 205132385371547941457867961, and was within collateral capacity, so it exercises no defect and is not the anchor. Price is not the defect: oracle 0xEC942bE8A8114bFD0396A5052c36027f2cA6a9d0 prices mMAMO from Chainlink-style aggregator 0xDBD37C274A70A8A3f92A227c843a6a8d3203afe6 ('MAMO / USD', 8 decimals, phase-2 round ids advancing every 14 seconds), which reported 0.01054105 at the first borrow and rose through 0.02447745, 0.04792164, 0.05741700, and 0.08386082 to 0.39844045 as the attacker bought MAMO. That is an off-chain feed reporting real market prices, so the rise is market conditions changing exposure, not age-bearing and not a code defect; five borrows fall in that window and are treated as loss scope, not as the anchor. No owner, admin, or compromised-signer call appears anywhere in the campaign, and deployer 0x10b83c88e88910cd5293324800d1a6e751004be5 is unrelated to both actor addresses. Age: the market is a Compound-style delegator, not a direct runtime - view calls STATICCALL itself with delegateToViewImplementation 0x0933c1ed before DELEGATECALLing the implementation - so the defect-bearing artifact is implementation 0x1fadff493529c3fcc7ee04f1f15d19816dda45b7, whose runtime hashes 0x67ef071c0cc14b498905c6928e1c4a5a03ed96697e7d7c85c244d12f7ba1f14c identically at the delegator's creation block, pre-exploit, and head. The delegator emitted exactly one NewImplementation event over its whole pre-incident history, log 867 of its own creation block 36665237, so no implementation change reset the clock; the MIP-B48 listing 0x46cb157d979d28cbfe76f077aad18c3ee5834b2aec91927ea5582007fca5fd05 at block 36889015:19 (log 67, 2025-10-15T22:29:37Z) is the later reset, with markets(mMAMO) reading unlisted and zero factor at block 36889014 and listed with factor 500000000000000000 at 36889015. 1787822399 minus 1760567377 equals 27255022 seconds. Loss follows the official reconciliation as documented in the incident loss notes.

notes: One fault episode: both donations, all 18 borrows, and the 595 liquidations belong to this incident, anchored on the first donation rather than on the first borrow. The linked operational account 0xd71dd9b6e634412713c47fe7ae02c628e338c384 supplied seed financing and received the consolidated DAI, and is named as an attacker address for campaign completeness.
